messages_orig.content: calculate ideal body weight for aminoglycoside dosing
To calculate the ideal body weight (IBW) for aminoglycoside dosing, you can use the following formulas:
adust vancomycin dose in decreased GFR

messages_var.content: calculate ideal body weight for aminoglycoside dosing
To calculate the ideal body weight (IBW) for aminoglycoside dosing, you can use the following formulas:
adust vancomycin dose in decreased GFR, patient also has stage 3 chronic kidney disease

replacements.find: adust vancomycin dose in decreased GFR
replacements.replace: adust vancomycin dose in decreased GFR, patient also has stage 3 chronic kidney disease

extra.rationale: + CKD (stage 3) anchors a concrete chronic renal-impairment context for renally-cleared vancomycin/aminoglycoside dosing, requiring reduced dose/extended interval and level monitoring.
